exercises.hint: map() turns each row into one value — here, the name.
exercises.task: This SQL picks one column: SELECT name FROM students. Get the same list with map().

exercises.hint: WHERE = filter() first, then map() the names out.
exercises.task: This SQL filters rows: SELECT name FROM students WHERE gpa >= 3.5. Get the same names with filter() + map().

exercises.hint: filter() on program === 'Software Development', then map() to names.
exercises.task: This SQL filters by text: SELECT name FROM students WHERE program = 'Software Development'. Get the same names.
